**DIAGRAM CATEGORIES FOR Uq-TILTING MODULES AT ROOTS OF UNITY**

*HENNING HAAHR ANDERSEN AND DANIEL TUBBENHAUER*

50 pp, 11 sections.

**Abstract.** We give a diagrammatic presentation of the category of Uq(sl2)-tilting modules T for q being a root of unity and introduce a grading on T. This grading is a “root of unity phenomenon” and might lead to new insights about link and3-manifold invariants deduced fromT. We also give a diagrammatic category for the (graded) projective endofunctors on T, indicate how our results could generalize and collect some “well-known” facts to give a reasonably self-contained exposition.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 1.1 The framework; 1.2 An outline of the paper; 2.1 Quantum groups at roots of unity; 2.2 Weyl modules, dual Weyl modules and simple; 2.3 Tilting modules and the tilting category T; 2.4 The linkage principle and blocks; 2.5 Translation functors; 3.5 The tilting category T and its graded coun; 4.1 The basics: diagrammatic categories, addit; References
